title: Finding blowups one vertex at a time
summary: An influential theorem of Nikiforov states that if an $N$-vertex graph $G$ contains at least $γN^h$ copies of some fixed $h$-vertex graph $H$, then $G$ contains an $H$-blowup of order $c_H(γ)\log N$. We provide a new proof of this theorem, which in particular improves the best known bound on the constant $c_H(γ)$. In contrast to previous proofs, our proof is iterative, finding the blowup one vertex at a time.
